description: The bar chart illustrates the percentage point difference in performance between mBERT and XLM-R across four different model configurations, with the y-axis representing the "% point difference" ranging from -0.2 to 0.2. The x-axis displays four distinct configurations: "hidden:[50], linear", "hidden:[], linear", "hidden:[100], ReLU", and "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU". For each configuration, two bars are shown: a light blue bar for mBERT and a dark blue bar for XLM-R. In the first configuration, "hidden:[50], linear", mBERT shows a significant negative difference (approximately -0.18), while XLM-R shows a small positive difference (around 0.02). In the second configuration, "hidden:[], linear", mBERT has a positive difference (approximately 0.08), and XLM-R has a much larger positive difference (around 0.21). In the third configuration, "hidden:[100], ReLU", mBERT has a negative difference (approximately -0.11), and XLM-R has a small positive difference (around 0.03). In the fourth configuration, "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU", mBERT has a negative difference (approximately -0.17), and XLM-R has a negative difference (around -0.12). The legend in the top right corner identifies the light blue bars as mBERT and the dark blue bars as XLM-R.
